title: Tunnel-auth: re-point authorization root for non-root egress mode + root trigger conditions
description: Follow-up from m9i4 (worker5). The Rust gateway now wires spec 06-security 8.11 (POST /.well-known/tunnel-auth + authorize_tunnel_egress data plane), but Gateway is always its own DODAG root, so TunnelAuthorizationTable::set_root is pinned to the gateway's own IID at construction (gateway.rs with_storage) — fail-closed, and no remote authorization can ever validate (accept_post requires OSCORE sender IID == root IID). Remaining: (1) when a non-root egress gateway mode exists, re-point the table root at the DIO-learned DODAG root IID and clear on root identity change (spec 'Root Re-election' — the table's set_root already atomically revokes); (2) root-side trigger conditions: send tunnel-auth on route install, route change, and approaching expiry (spec 8.11 'Trigger Conditions'), using tunnel_auth::build_root_post; (3) authorization table persistence/restart semantics per spec 'Interaction with Trust Boundaries' (mesh-lifetime state, restart clears).
